name: Health in the World: Interdisciplinary Perspectives
description: This course will focus on the way that experience, concepts and institutions for “health” are embedded in an always transforming world, thus requiring multi-disciplinary approaches combining both Humanities and Social Sciences (thus going beyond "Health Humanities") through lecture modules by diverse experts, films, documentaries and site-visits. The course will allow students from various different disciplines, including Cognitive Sciences, Design, Management to analyse the complexity of health problems and health care, connect HSS knowledge production to health-related SDG goals,.and appreciate the function of cultural production in engaging with and communicating these concerns to wider society.
